definitions.gloss: all one has, everything available, the whole lot
definitions.explanation: Emphasizes using or giving everything that exists, often implying determination or desperation.

examples.japanese: ありったけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: Put out all the strength one has.

examples.japanese: ありったけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勇気|ゆうき}→勇気：02499_yuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{絞|しぼ}った→振り絞る：12817_furishiboru⟧。
examples.english: I mustered all the courage I had.

examples.japanese: ありったけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧「⟦{助|たす}けて→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{叫|さけ}んだ→叫ぶ：02108_sakebu⟧。
examples.english: I shouted 'Help!' with all my voice.

notes:
ありったけ means "all one has" or "everything available," emphasizing using the full extent of something. It always modifies a noun with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.

WRITING:
Usually written in hiragana. The kanji form {有|あ}りっ{丈|たけ} exists but is uncommon.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ありったけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧: all one's strength
- ありったけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勇気|ゆうき}→勇気：02499_yuuki⟧: all the courage one has
- ありったけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: at the top of one's voice
- ありったけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知恵|ちえ}→知恵：03428_chie⟧: all one's wisdom
- ありったけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{愛情|あいじょう}→愛情：01673_aijou⟧: all one's love

USAGE:
Conveys intensity and determination — the speaker is giving or using absolutely everything they have. Often appears in dramatic or emotional contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{精一杯|せいいっぱい}→精一杯：13774_seiippai⟧: with all one's might (more everyday)
- ⟦{全力|ぜんりょく}→全力：11637_zenryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: with full effort
